---
description: Explain a security alert in plain language and propose a minimal fix
---

You are helping an introductory audience understand a code scanning alert.

1. Name the vulnerability class and explain it in two sentences a non-specialist can follow.
2. Identify the **source** (where untrusted data enters) and the **sink** (where it becomes dangerous) in the selected code.
3. Propose the smallest safe fix, following `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
4. Suggest one test that would fail before the fix and pass after it.
